JOYSTAR Roadster Kids Balance Bike - 12" & 14"
Unlock your child's potential with the JOYSTAR Roadster Balance Bike. Designed to bridge the gap between walking and cycling, the Roadster helps toddlers aged 2-6 develop the balance and coordination needed for a smooth transition to pedal bikes—without ever needing training wheels.

Learning made fun: The JOYSTAR Roadster helps kids find their balance early.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered with a low-step frame and precision steering, the Roadster provides a stable, confidence-boosting platform for every little rider."
Safety-First Construction
The JOYSTAR Roadster features a high-tensile HI-TEN steel frame, providing a robust yet lightweight structure that kids can easily manage. With its ball-bearing headset, the bike offers smooth and stable steering, ensuring your child stays in control while navigating sidewalks and paths.

Precision ball-bearing steering for maximum control and stability.

Key Features & Benefits

Growth Ready: The quick-release seat clamp allow for effortless height adjustments as your child grows.

Airless Tires: 12" and 14" EVA polymer tires are puncture-proof and maintenance-free, providing a smooth ride on any surface.

Built-in Footrest: Allows toddlers to find their center of gravity and practice coasting safely.

Custom Style: Each bike includes a front handlebar basket (or doll seat) and DIY decals for a personalized look.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get riding in record time. The JOYSTAR Roadster arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and simple instructions, setup typically takes less than 10 minutes, so your little one can start their adventure immediately.

Assembly Guide: Quick setup to get your Roadster ready for action.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: Building confidence and coordination with the Roadster.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR stands behind every bike we build, offering peace of mind for parents and a lifetime of fun for kids:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: High-tensile steel frames are protected against defects for the life of the original owner.

Dedicated Support: Access our professional customer service team for any technical or assembly questions.
